printer_card.confirm_stop: Are you sure you want to stop the print?
printer_card.confirm_power_off: Are you sure you want to power off the printer?
printer_card.confirm_power_off_printing: A print is in progress. Are you sure you want to power off the printer?
printer_card.note_device: Picking a device fills in the fields below that are still empty. Use the button to replace every field, including ones you set yourself. The power switch is never filled in, because the integration does not provide one.
printer_card.note_clear_resets: Use Reset to Defaults at the bottom to undo these.
printer_card.note_auto_colors: Turn Automatic off to choose a color yourself.
printer_card.status_device_empty: No entities from this integration were found on that device.
printer_card.helper_auto_status_icon: Automatic: follows the print state, orange while paused, red on error, green when idle or finished.
printer_card.helper_auto_progress_ring: Automatic: follows the print state, matching the status icon.
printer_card.helper_auto_status_bg: Automatic: blends into the card background.
printer_card.helper_auto_telemetry_icon: Automatic: uses the theme's secondary text color.
printer_card.helper_auto_telemetry_text: Automatic: uses the theme's primary text color.
printer_card.helper_device: Your printer, as set up by this integration
printer_card.helper_name: Display name for the printer card
printer_card.helper_camera: Camera entity for live video feed
printer_card.helper_power: Your own smart plug for the printer, if you have one (shows a Power button when set). Not filled in from the device.
printer_card.helper_show_power_button: Show the Power button when a power switch entity is configured
printer_card.helper_light: Switch entity for printer light control
printer_card.helper_custom_btn: Any entity to trigger (Button, Script, Switch, etc.)
printer_card.helper_button_order: List of buttons to show in order (pause, resume, stop, light, power, custom)
printer_card.helper_hide_box_temp: Hide the chamber temperature pill even when a sensor is configured
printer_card.editor_error_msg: There was an error loading the visual editor. You can still edit your configuration using YAML.

cfs_card.schema_show_type_in_mini: Show Filament Type in Mini Mode
cfs_card.toast_no_device: Could not identify the printer for this card. Check the entities in the card configuration.
cfs_card.toast_multiple_devices: This card mixes entities from more than one printer, so material editing is disabled.
cfs_card.toast_printer_busy: Cannot edit material while the printer is busy
cfs_card.tooltip_edit_locked: Editing is disabled while the printer is busy
cfs_card.toast_temp_range_invalid: Maximum temperature must not be below the minimum
cfs_card.toast_colour_invalid: Color must be six hex digits, for example #06c84f
cfs_card.toast_external_not_supported: This printer does not report a box id for the external spool, so it cannot be edited
cfs_card.warn_box_id_guessed: The target box or slot was inferred from the card layout; check both match the printer before saving
cfs_card.toast_preset_name_required: Give the preset a name first
cfs_card.hint_delete_preset: Dashed swatches are your own presets; right-click one to delete it.
